tooltip.text: Mouse wheel or drag to scroll damage types horizontally

windowclass.name: dwb_viewport
windowclass.script: local panel; function setPanel(w) panel=w; end function onDrop(x,y,drag) if panel then return panel.onDrop(x,y,drag); end end function onWheel(notches) if panel then return panel.onWheel(notches); end return true; end function onClickDown(button) return true; end

comboboxc.name: dtype
comboboxc.script: function onSelect(value) window.changeType(value); end function onWheel(notches) return window.onWheel(notches); end function onClickDown(button,x,y) if button==2 then return true; end return super.onClickDown(button,x,y); end function onClickRelease(button,x,y) if button==2 then return true; end return super.onClickRelease(button,x,y); end

windowlist.name: dice
windowlist.script: function onDrop(x,y,drag) return window.onDrop(x,y,drag); end function onWheel(notches) return window.onWheel(notches); end function onClickDown(button) return button==2; end function onClickRelease(button) return button==2; end

genericcontrol.name: face
genericcontrol.script: function onClickDown(button,x,y) return window.click(button); end function onClickRelease(button,x,y) return window.release(button); end function onMenuSelection(...) window.menuSelection(...); end function onDoubleClick(x,y) return window.doubleClick(); end function onDragStart(button,x,y,draginfo) return window.drag(draginfo); end function onDrop(x,y,draginfo) return window.onDrop(x,y,draginfo); end function onWheel(notches) return window.onWheel(notches); end

basicnumberc.name: fixed
basicnumberc.script: function onValueChanged() window.fixedChanged(); end function onDrop(x,y,draginfo) return window.onDrop(x,y,draginfo); end function onClickDown(button,x,y) if button==2 then return true; end if super.onClickDown then return super.onClickDown(button,x,y); end end function onClickRelease(button,x,y) if button==2 then return true; end if super.onClickRelease then return super.onClickRelease(button,x,y); end end function onWheel(notches) if Input.isControlPressed() then setValue(getValue()+notches); return true; end return window.onWheel(notches); end

windowclass.name: dwb_approval
windowclass.script: local id; function setData(ctx) id=ctx.id; label.setValue(ctx.publicName .. " / " .. ctx.label); end function confirm() DWB.approve(id); end function reject() DWB.reject(id); end

windowclass.name: dwb_save
windowclass.script: local p; function setPlan(plan) p=DWBModel.copy(plan); name.setValue(p.label); paper.setStaticBounds(18,45,414,163); end function updateName() if p then handle.setText(name.getValue()); end end function dragPreset(drag) if not p then return false; end drag.setType("dwbpreset"); drag.setStringData(Utility.encodeJSON(DWBModel.preset(p,name.getValue()))); drag.setDescription(name.getValue()); drag.setIcon("action_damage"); return true; end

windowclass.name: dwb_reroll_confirm
windowclass.script: local panel; local index; function setData(w,i,count) panel=w; index=i; paper.setStaticBounds(18,45,414,153); message.setValue("Reroll this die? Rerolls this turn: " .. count .. ". You must use the new result. Undo still returns to dice setup."); end function confirm() if panel then panel.confirmReroll(index); end close(); end

windowclass.name: dwb_reopen
windowclass.script: function onInit() local id=DB.getValue(getDatabaseNode(),"request",""); close(); DWB.reopen(id); end
